# OpenSea

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 13 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: NFT marketplace, signed out: a Next.js token layer of channel-triplet --color-* pairs, page #080808 and surface #0c0c0c in dark, brand blue #0086ff, gtAmerica with gtAmericaMono for prices, pill nav and filters, a 480px connect dialog at radius 12px, and green #47bb64 / red #e24756 change figures.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (home, collection, activity, discover, drops, tools and terms were public; the connect dialog was opened and closed; no wallet was connected and nothing was submitted). Dark was the live theme. Light is the declared .light pair, resolved on a probe, and was not switched on.. Themes: dark.

A token set and component reference for OpenSea's public signed-out marketplace. It was read on **2026-11-19** from opensea.io in the T3 preview browser, signed out, at a measured **1440 x 900** (devicePixelRatio 2) and **390 x 844**. Captured: the home, a collection (CryptoPunks), activity, discover/art, drops, tools, and the platform terms. The Connect with OpenSea dialog was opened from Sign in and closed with Escape. Nothing was submitted. No wallet was connected. Google, Apple, email, MetaMask, WalletConnect, Robinhood, and More Wallet Options were not pressed.

OpenSea declares a real token layer. `:root, .dark` and `.light` set `--color-*` names as channel triplets (`12 12 12`) and as `rgb(var(--color-*) / percent)`. The live page was dark (`html.dark`, `color-scheme: dark`). UI type is **gtAmerica**. Stats and prices are **gtAmericaMono**. The brand blue is `#0086ff` (`--color-blue-3`). The page is `#080808`. Selected nav and filter pills are `#161616` with a pill radius. **Boundary:** rewards and settings bounce to the connect dialog. Buying, listing, and a connected wallet were not entered.

## Typography

6 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: gtAmerica, gtAmericaMono.

### Fonts (from README.md)

| Family | Where | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| gtAmerica | Nav, titles, body, buttons, terms | Proprietary (Grilli Type). Weights 400, 500, and 600 were loaded. Not committed. Tokens fall back to ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif |
| gtAmericaMono | Floor price, volume, listed, percent change | Proprietary. Weights 400 and 500 were loaded. Not committed. Tokens fall back to ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace |
| system-ui | support.opensea.io only | The help center's own stack. Not the marketplace UI |

`gtAmerica Fallback` and `gtAmericaMono Fallback` are `local("Arial")` size-adjust faces. They are not the product face.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The screenshots and crops are reconstructions, drawn with Pillow from the measured boxes, including [screenshots/home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png), which the gallery shows as this package's cover. Positions and colours come from computed styles. The wordmark in those PNGs is a blue circle, not the SVG paths. The style guide uses the system sans for gtAmerica. That family is proprietary and is not in the package.

Desktop Sign in was a transparent pill. Phone Sign in, at 390, was a filled `#0086ff` pill. Both readings are live. Do not treat one as the other's hover.

Focus on the email field was `outline: none 1px #99c8ff`. The field wrapper's border did not change. Google's hover moved the button from `#0c0c0c` / `#202020` to `#161616` / `#2c2c2c`. Close showed no computed change on hover. No error, disabled, or loading state was on the public pages.

Help center colours are a separate Zendesk skin (`support.opensea.io`, `--body-primary-color: #1a1a1a`, system-ui). They are not the marketplace `--color-*` tokens.

Cookiebot (`--cc-*`) and Sonner (`--gray1` through `--gray12`, toast colours) are third-party layers. They are recorded in the stylesheet harvest and not tokenised as OpenSea colour.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do paint the page `#080808` and the raised surface `#0c0c0c`.** The live `html` background was `#080808` (`--color-bg-app`). Dialogs and the footer use the same ink. [screenshots/home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)
- **Do set UI type in gtAmerica, and prices in gtAmericaMono.** Titles are 32px / 48px at weight 500. The tools hero is 60px / 63px with `-1.5px` tracking. Stat labels are 12px / 15px mono. [components.md](components.md)
- **Do make nav, filters, and Sign in pills.** Computed radius was `1.67772e7px`. Selected pills are `#161616` with a `#2c2c2c` border on filters. [components/crops/button-nav-selected.png](components/crops/button-nav-selected.png)
- **Do use `#0086ff` for the brand action.** Phone Sign in and Buy Now both computed to `--color-blue-3`. The wordmark circle is the same blue. [components/crops/button-signin-phone.png](components/crops/button-signin-phone.png)
- **Do keep the connect dialog at 480px, radius 12px, on a 60% black overlay.** [screenshots/signin-dark-dialog.png](screenshots/signin-dark-dialog.png)
- **Don't treat the PNGs as live screenshots.** The preview browser did not produce frames. Read values from [tokens.json](tokens.json).
- **Don't style a connected wallet, a buy, or settings from this package.** Those routes bounced to the connect dialog or were not entered.
- **Don't submit from this package.** Email, OAuth, and wallet rows were measured at rest or hover only.
